{"id": "adcca375-d74b-4b42-9012-a71be4970ecc", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Those checks are reported under the **UPGRADE_READINESS** category in EKS Cluster Insights \u2014 AWS's own term for it is \"upgrade insights.\" Kube-proxy version skew, kubelet version skew, and add-on compatibility all fall under this category (the other category, `MISCONFIGURATION`, covers \"configuration insights\" and is specific to EKS Hybrid Nodes setups).\n\nAs for labeling them \"CP checks\" \u2014 that's not an AWS-defined term for this feature. The official categories exposed by the EKS `InsightsFilter` API are `UPGRADE_READINESS`, `MISCONFIGURATION`, and `ROLLBACK_READINESS`. There's no \"CP\" (control plane) designation in the documented category set, so I wouldn't label them that way in a grading context \u2014 stick with \"upgrade insights\" (`UPGRADE_READINESS`) as the correct series name.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

{"id": "8a1b975a-7101-4959-8c47-2c9df77fcf72", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Those checks are reported under the **UPGRADE_READINESS** category in EKS Cluster Insights \u2014 AWS's own term for it is \"upgrade insights.\" Kube-proxy version skew, kubelet version skew, and add-on compatibility all fall under this category (the other category, `MISCONFIGURATION`, covers \"configuration insights\" and is specific to EKS Hybrid Nodes setups).\n\nAs for labeling them \"CP checks\" \u2014 that's not an AWS-defined term for this feature. The official categories exposed by the EKS `InsightsFilter` API are `UPGRADE_READINESS`, `MISCONFIGURATION`, and `ROLLBACK_READINESS`. There's no \"CP\" (control plane) designation in the documented category set, so I wouldn't label them that way in a grading context \u2014 stick with \"upgrade insights\" (`UPGRADE_READINESS`) as the correct series name."}]}
